case_title: MONTGOMERY WEST VS ADDISON-WESTLEY PUBLISHING COMPANY

docket_entries.description: PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT ADDISON-WESTLEY PUBLISHING COMPANY

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MONTGOMERY WEST RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT ADDISON-WESTLEY PUBLISHING COMPANY $3,500.00 PRINCIPAL, $39.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $3,539.00, MARY COOPER DISMISSED BY PLAINTIFF. SUIT IS AGAINST ADDISON WESLEY STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,500.00 FILED BY MONTGOMERY WEST AS TO DEFENDANT ADDISON-WESTLEY PUBLISHING COMPANY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-07-1994 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 05
